items.title: User Education Lead
items.description: About the team Customer Education helps people and organizations build the skills and confidence to use AI effectively. We create courses, live learning, community programs and product education that help people apply OpenAI’s products to their work. About the role We’re looking for a User Education Lead who is excited about what AI can make possible for people at work and wants to bring more people along on that journey. You’ll lead education for enterprise users who are getting started with AI or need help turning early experimentation into everyday use. You’ll help people discover what’s possible, build confidence through practice and develop the judgment to use AI well. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both building and teaching. You’ll explore new products, work directly with learners, create practical education and test what helps people make progress. You’ll develop role-based learning and new approaches to teaching AI, then turn what works into frameworks and resources that can reach more people. You’ll work closely with teams across Customer Education, Product and go-to-market to connect this foundational learning to the broader customer experience and help learners progress as their skills grow. In this role, you will: - Own the education roadmap for people getting started with AI at work. Identify the skills they need, where they get stuck and the opportunities to help them make meaningful progress. - Build and deliver role-based learning. Create courses, live sessions, demonstrations and exercises grounded in the work people actually do, helping learners apply AI to useful tasks in their own roles. - Develop and test new approaches to AI education. Experiment with how concepts are explained, how practice is structured and how learners are supported. Turn what works into frameworks and resources that others can adapt and use. - Help people build lasting skills and confidence. Design learning that helps people move from a first useful experience to independent, repeat use, with clear paths into more advanced education. - Stay close to the product and the learner. Explore new capabilities firsthand, listen to customers and work with Product and customer-facing teams to keep education relevant as their needs change. - Measure and improve your work. Assess whether people are developing skills and applying what they learn, then use those insights to improve the learning experience and guide future investment. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have built and led education programs that help people develop practical skills and change how they work. - Are an engaging teacher and clear writer who can make complex ideas accessible and exciting without oversimplifying them. - Are energized by AI’s potential for workers and curious about how to help people who are uncertain, skeptical or just getting started. - Use AI actively in your own work, test what you teach and can explain both where it helps and where human judgment matters. - Love finding better ways to teach. You listen to learners, try new approaches, learn from the results and share what works. - Can set a focused direction, build strong partnerships and deliver high-quality work as products and customer needs evolve. Nice to have: - Experience designing learning for different professional roles or functions. - Experience creating self-serve education or resources that customers and partners can deliver themselves. items.title: Senior Global Security Investigator
items.description: About the Team Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture. About the Role We are seeking a senior Global Security Investigator with a technical background to lead complex, long-running security investigations involving a full spectrum of threats – whether originating from internal employees, external threat actors, or supply chain partners. This role is about seeing the full chessboard and independently driving complex, multi-month cases across cyber, physical, and human domains. In this role you will: - Independently conduct comprehensive security investigations from initial detection to resolution, including cases involving insiders, external actors, and supply chain and third-party risks. - Lead proactive, data-driven threat-hunting efforts that weave together disparate signals to surface undetected insider or external threats before they escalate into incidents. - Perform comprehensive technical analysis of complex hardware, software, and supplier supply chains to identify, enumerate, and mitigate risks. - Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Human Resources, Legal, Security, and IT, and external stakeholders or law enforcement when necessary. - Collaborate with technical counterparts to enhance detections, resolve telemetry gaps, and implement new capabilities to identify security issues involving cyber, physical, and human domains. - Collect, preserve, and analyze evidence from a variety of sources, including log data, digital forensics, subject interviews, access records, threat intelligence, and open-source intelligence (OSINT), to support investigative findings. - Continuously improve investigative procedures and security controls based on investigations and lessons learned. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience) and 8+ years of investigative experience in counterintelligence, insider risk, forensic investigations, cybersecurity, supply chain security, or related domains. - Unimpeachable integrity, sound judgment, and the ability to handle confidential matters with discretion. - An active US security clearance, or willingness and eligibility to obtain one. - Deep specialization in geopolitical threat domains, with hands-on experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating adversarial risks through tailored countermeasures. - Expert knowledge of common security tooling, including EDR, DLP, UEBA, SIEM, SOAR and other related platforms. - Demonstrated ability to independently write complex queries, automate data workflows, and analyze structured datasets. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex findings into clear, actionable reports and explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. - Exceptional collaboration skills with the ability to work across diverse teams (HR, Legal, IT, etc.) to lead projects and investigations with minimal guidance. items.title: Software Engineer, Agent Platform
items.description: About the Team The Agent Platform team at OpenAI builds the production systems that bring useful AI agents to users around the world. We provide the platform that enables agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with software reliably and securely at scale. We work closely with product, research, and infrastructure teams to turn new agent capabilities into dependable product experiences. Our work spans the execution environments, APIs, and integrations that support agentic products such as Codex and tool use in ChatGPT. We focus on how agents run in production: making it easy to launch new capabilities, supporting growing demand, and improving the performance and reliability of the systems behind user experiences. Some of the hardest problems in making agents useful emerge when they meet real-world workloads. We build the platform that helps agents handle those workloads safely, recover when things go wrong, and deliver consistent results. About the Role As a Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will build and scale the services that power agentic products at OpenAI. You’ll work closely with product engineers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers to bring new capabilities from early prototypes to production. Your work will include designing APIs and services, improving agent execution and orchestration, and building the integrations needed to support increasingly capable agents. You’ll help launch new experiences while strengthening the reliability, observability, and efficiency of the platform underneath them. We’re looking for engineers with experience building large-scale backend systems or infrastructure who enjoy working close to products and users. You should be comfortable moving quickly through ambiguous problems while making thoughtful decisions about security, performance, and long-term maintainability. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Build and operate production services that enable agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with external systems. - Design APIs and platform abstractions that make it easier for product teams to build and launch agentic experiences. - Develop orchestration systems that manage agent execution, state, resource allocation, retries, and recovery. - Improve platform reliability, latency, and efficiency through performance optimization, observability, and capacity planning. - Partner with product, research, security, and infrastructure teams to bring new agent capabilities into production. - Own systems through their full lifecycle, from design and implementation to rollout, monitoring, and ongoing operation. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have experience building and operating large-scale backend services, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure. - Enjoy building shared platforms and APIs that help other engineers move faster. - Can take an early prototype, turn it into a reliable service, and evolve it as usage grows. - Have a strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, failure modes, and resource management. - Care about how infrastructure decisions affect the user experience, including responsiveness, reliability, and predictable behavior. - Are comfortable working across service boundaries and collaborating with teams to solve problems from end to end. - Have experience with cloud platforms, containers, orchestration systems, or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform. - Are interested in secure execution environments, sandboxing, and the challenges of running agent workloads in production. items.title: President, Bitstamp Europe
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Bitstamp Europe S.A. is Robinhood’s EU-regulated crypto exchange and the company’s primary licensing hub for European operations. Under Robinhood, Bitstamp Europe is the cornerstone of the company’s ambition to become Europe’s leading regulated crypto platform - serving institutional, retail and B2B clients through spot, perpetual futures, and crypto-as-a-service offerings. As President, Bitstamp Europe, you will serve as the general manager and senior-most leader of Bitstamp Europe S.A., with full P&L accountability for Robinhood’s European crypto business. You will be the company’s most senior face to European regulators - primarily the CSSF in Luxembourg, with whom you are expected to qualify as an Authorized Manager and to institutional partners, counterparties, and key stakeholders across the region. This is a high-visibility, externally facing leadership role requiring equal mastery of financial regulation, business strategy, and team leadership. This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Serve as the CSSF-recognized Authorized Manager and primary regulatory representative for Bitstamp Europe's MiCA CASP, Payment Institution and related licenses across all business lines. Lead supervisory engagement on examinations, license conditions, notifications, outsourcing and regulatory change. Clear new products and markets for launch quickly, so regulation speeds up revenue growth. Own the P&L of Bitstamp Europe S.A. and be accountable for revenue growth across institutional and B2B in the EEA. Drive volume, fee yield and market share, and keep the cost base disciplined as revenue scales. Define and execute Bitstamp Europe’s regional go-to-market strategy in close partnership with Robinhood’s global product, engineering, compliance, and BD leadership Lead, grow, and develop the Luxembourg-based team - recruit senior talent, define organizational structure, and preserve Bitstamp’s culture of performance and integrity Own institutional and strategic partnership relationships across Europe, including B2B crypto-as-a-service clients, bank liquidity partnerships, and key institutional accounts Proactively navigate the evolving European regulatory landscape - MiCA, MiFID II, DORA, and future frameworks - ensuring sustained CSSF compliance and shaping regulatory engagements What you bring Significant experience in regulated financial services with meaningful European presence - ideally combining fintech or crypto depth with deep working knowledge of Luxembourg or EU financial regulation Demonstrated experience qualifying or operating as an Approved Person or Authorized Manager under European regulatory frameworks (CSSF, FCA, DNB, BaFin, or equivalent); ability to qualify as a CSSF Authorized Manager is required Deep command of MiCA, MiFID II, and the CSSF’s regulatory expectations for crypto-asset service providers; working knowledge of DORA, AML/CFT frameworks, and PSD2 P&L ownership at scale in a regulated European financial entity - you have run a business, not just managed a function Proven track record building and closing institutional B2B relationships and strategic partnerships in European financial markets Experience leading through corporate integration or significant organizational change - managing competing stakeholders while keeping a business performing Fluency in English required; French or Luxembourgish a plus Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier. We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely. To achieve these goals, we're seeking exceptional machine learning researchers with deep expertise in training and evaluating frontier models. In this role, you'll work end to end across the model stack, developing training environments, rewards, data, and evaluations that measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks, and carrying what works into production training runs. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and that learn from real-world feedback. A background in engineering or the sciences is a plus but not required. Key responsibilities Design, build, and study reinforcement learning environments, rewards, and training data that improve Claude's capabilities in engineering and the applied sciences Create benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that measure model performance on realistic engineering and scientific workflows Develop simulation-based training environments and verifiers, working with domain experts to validate them against real-world data Develop approaches to long-horizon task completion, multi-agent collaboration, and complex reasoning essential for real engineering and research work Research how models can learn efficiently from experiments and real-world feedback Study how environments and rewards behave in large-scale training, including robustness, calibration, and generalization, so that training produces models that are both capable and well aligned Scale research ideas from prototype to production training runs Collaborate with domain experts and industry partners to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and turn that feedback into training and evaluation signal Help chart how Claude’s engineering capabilities reach real-world use: where they matter most, what stands in the way of adoption, and how that should shape research priorities Minimum qualifications Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX Hands-on experience training or evaluating machine learning models Track record of machine learning research: forming hypotheses, designing and running experiments, and drawing sound conclusions from the results Ability to implement your own research ideas and diagnose problems in complex systems Ability to learn unfamiliar technical fields quickly and work productively with experts in them Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving problems Excitement about improving Claude’s scientific capabilities and the downstream impact on science and technology Commitment to developing AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications Experience with reinforcement learning and pre-training on large language models, including environment and reward design Familiarity with large-scale language model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines Published research or practical experience in AI for science or engineering, or in long-horizon reasoning A degree or work experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, systems, or manufacturing engineering, applied physics, or computational simulation Experience building simulators, surrogate models, or simulation-based environments and verifiers, and calibrating and validating them against real-world data Experience with large-scale data pipelines and technical or multimodal datasets Demonstrated ability to work across multiple domains, such as language modeling, systems engineering, and scientific computing The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $500,000 — $850,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: BIM Designer & Coordinator: Civil
items.description: About the Team Industrial Compute develops the infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s AI systems. Our Design organization connects engineering, construction, and digital delivery to support complex data center campuses from initial planning through deployment. Working with internal teams, design consultants, and construction partners, we develop coordinated designs that address site constraints, infrastructure requirements, and future growth. Our BIM team provides the models and workflows needed to deliver consistently across the portfolio. About the Role We are seeking a hands-on Civil BIM Designer & Coordinator with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience to support the planning and design of large-scale, mission-critical data center campuses and associated power generation, energy storage, and utility facilities. In this role, you will develop, coordinate, and maintain civil models using Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Your scope will include site layouts, grading, drainage, roads, and utilities, coordinating buildings with generating equipment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, substations, and cooling systems. You will work closely with civil engineers, BIM team, discipline designers, equipment vendors, and delivery partners to turn engineering requirements into clear models and deliverables. Your work will support early design reviews, resolve site coordination challenges, and establish repeatable civil BIM practices across concurrent projects. Detailed engineering requirements and specialist analyses will be provided by the responsible engineers. We are looking for a hands-on civil specialist who can independently manage modeling assignments, communicate design dependencies, and maintain quality as projects evolve. Key Responsibilities - Advance feasibility, constructability, and phasing: Prepare layout, grading, routing, and earthwork options for early design reviews; incorporate noise, exhaust dispersion, heat-rejection, safety, and environmental constraints. Model heavy-equipment delivery routes, turning movements, crane areas, laydown, maintenance clearances, staged construction, temporary-to-permanent generation transitions, and future expansion. - Lead civil site development: Create and maintain surfaces, grading and earthwork models, equipment and building pads, roads, alignments, profiles, and corridors. Incorporate flood protection, stormwater management, and containment or separation process-drainage requirements. - Develop and coordinate plant utility systems: Model gravity and pressure networks for gas supply, cooling and process water, fire water, wastewater, electrical duct banks, and communications. Coordinate utility models, routes, corridors, crossings, connections, and clearances with engineers, consultants, utility providers, vendors, and construction partners. - Integrate campus and power-generation infrastructure: Coordinate civil models with buildings, power plants, BESS, substations, water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, cooling systems, and other site utilities. Support simple-cycle and combined-cycle gas turbine, reciprocating engine, and CHP layouts while incorporating equipment separation, service access, and fire access. - Coordinate equipment, foundation, and thermal interfaces: Integrate vendor general arrangements, foundation footprints, equipment elevations, trenches, pits, and pipe-support locations with inputs from structural, geotechnical, mechanical, and electrical engineers. Coordinate civil interfaces for heat-recovery steam generators, steam-turbine facilities, heat exchangers, cooling towers, air-cooled condensers, radiator arrays, and thermal-distribution corridors. - Govern civil model data and multidisciplinary alignment: Manage Civil 3D data shortcuts, external references, coordinate systems, styles, templates, and parts libraries. Coordinate Civil 3D, Revit, vendor, and combined-discipline models; verify coordinates, origins, elevations, units, orientation, and model alignment in Navisworks. - Drive coordination and quality: Lead model reviews, investigate clashes and spatial conflicts, communicate design changes, and track issues through resolution. Review civil models and drawings for completeness, reference integrity, consistency, and compliance with project BIM requirements. - Deliver and improve civil BIM: Prepare plans, profiles, sections, model exports, review packages, and model-based quantities appropriate to each project phase. Maintain reusable content, document workflows, and improve delivery across data center, power-generation, energy-storage, and utility projects. Qualifications - Minimum 8 years of civil design, BIM modeling, or civil infrastructure drafting experience, plus a relevant degree/diploma or equivalent practical experience. - Experience supporting mission-critical facilities or complex industrial infrastructure across multiple disciplines. - Advanced Civil 3D and AutoCAD proficiency, including grading, corridors, utility networks, sheet production, data shortcuts, references, coordinate systems, and model dependencies. - Experience with site-survey data, GIS, point clouds, NavVis or similar laser-scanning/reality-capture workflows. - Experience with Navisworks, Revizto, and Autodesk Forma for model coordination, issue tracking, and markups. - Ability to independently deliver civil packages, interpret engineering and vendor information, identify missing inputs, and escalate engineering decisions appropriately. - Strong communication and organizational skills across changing priorities and concurrent projects. items.title: GTM Recruiter
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenLabs is building one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies - and we're looking for a GTM Recruiter to partner with our Revenue org. You'll run full-cycle recruiting across our high volumes roles, partnering with leaders across our Sales Development, Corporate, Mid-Market, and Partnerships team to hire world class talent. This isn't a conventional recruiting role. You'll work alongside GTM leaders to shape role strategy, design world class candidate experiences, and close exceptional talent across North America. You know what great looks like in a Revenue org - whether from building GTM teams at exceptional tech companies or from your own experience exceeding hiring goals. This role is centered around high ownership, making data driven decisions, and building hiring processes and pipelines that scale. WHAT YOUR DAY MIGHT LOOK LIKE - Full-cycle recruiting for a broad range of GTM roles including Sales Development Representatives, Account Executives, and Revenue Partnerships. - Partnering closely with GTM leadership to refine role requirements, set hiring strategy, and identify key success signals that elevate quality of hire. - Designing and managing candidate pipelines with a focus on efficiency, transparency, and a white glove, high touch experience. - Acting as a trusted advisor to hiring teams, providing market insights, role benchmarks, and data-driven recommendations. - Representing ElevenLabs externally - every interaction with candidates is an opportunity to bring our brand and values to life. REQUIREMENTS - Full-cycle GTM recruiting experience for a high growth startup, with a strong track record closing quota-carrying roles across Sales roles. - Able to manage high volume and complex searches across multiple priorities without sacrificing quality or urgency. - Strong partner to hiring leaders - you influence with clarity, data, and operational rigor. - Exceptional communicator - you craft compelling role narratives and deliver a high-touch experience for candidates and stakeholders alike. - Preference for this role to be based in New York City. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with candidates based in New York City strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. items.title: Applied Scientist, Engineering
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier. We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely. We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real-world feedback. Key responsibilities Design and implement evaluation methodologies for assessing AI model capabilities relevant to engineering and applied science research and applications Design realistic tasks and training environments, and curate data from your field Develop and validate simulations and computational tools for your field, and calibrate them against real-world data Work with industry partners, manufacturers, and labs to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and bring that real-world feedback into evaluation and training Think through how Claude's engineering capabilities can permeate the real world: where they can have the most impact across industry and research, and what it takes to get them adopted Advise the team on which problems, tools, and workflows matter most in your field Collaborate with domain experts and partners to establish benchmarks and gather high-quality data for training Translate between engineering domain knowledge and machine learning objectives Minimum qualifications Deep expertise and hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool Hands-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards Preferred qualifications 5+ years of hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline Ph.D. in an engineering or applied science field, or equivalent industry experience Industry experience in product design and manufacturing, or in developing engineering or scientific simulation software Breadth across more than one discipline, or across several stages of the path from design to production Familiarity with modern AI model training methods Track record of building high-fidelity solvers or simulation engines that were validated against real-world data and used in practice Experience working with manufacturers, vendors, contract research organizations, or academic labs Experience managing data pipelines and working with large-scale technical datasets Publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific or engineering software The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Talent Lead
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make. You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 40+ recruiters and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them. The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLabs; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet. In this role you will: - Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals. - Responsible for owning the scope of Talent Operations in partnership with the Talent Operations Lead: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction. - Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout. - Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market. - Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies. - Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience. - Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy. We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early. REQUIREMENTS - Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies. - Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance. - Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent. - Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI. - Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy. - Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it. - Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment. - Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy. - Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Internal Communications Manager, Product
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking an Internal Communications Manager to serve as a dedicated communications partner to our Product organization. Internal communications at Anthropic is not a support function that plans meetings and sends newsletters. The best people in this role operate like advisors who embed themselves deeply in the orgs they support, earn a seat at the leadership table, write on behalf of executives, and see around corners, anticipating what the organization will need to hear before anyone asks for it. There are traditional elements to the role too, like all-hands planning and org change announcements, and you'll run those with operational excellence. But the heart of the job is more creative and will require you to find ways to connect the rest of the company to some of the most consequential and least visible work at Anthropic, and making the line between that work and our mission clear and strong. Product is the bridge between what our models can do and what our customers’ needs today. Capabilities are improving constantly, and priorities shift as the models improve, and launches can come together very quickly as a result. For much of the company, it can be hard to keep up with what's shipping, what's changing, and why it matters. Your job is to help people make sense of that pace by understanding the work, and the people doing it, well enough to tell its story credibly, and to help its leaders communicate with clarity and candor as the company scales. Responsibilities Own the internal communications strategy for your portfolio, becoming an expert in the team's work and a trusted member of its leadership team Serve as a hands-on advisor to executives - help them think through what to say and when, draft communications in their voice, and give them honest counsel, especially in moments when that’s challenging or uncomfortable. Translate deeply technical work into narratives that land with employees across every function, without losing the substance Get creative about how you connect people to the work - don't default to creating a slide deck when a demo or something no one has tried yet would land better Anticipate communications needs before they arrive (e.g. launches, incidents, organizational change, moments of external attention) and have a plan ready for how we’ll bring employees along Design and implement strategies to boost signal and reduce noise, so employees know what's important and what it means for them Plan and execute internal fora like all-hands and AMAs with operational excellence Exercise sound judgment with sensitive material, especially where security work requires care about what is shared, with whom, and when Partner closely with the broader internal communications team to ensure updates are accurately and consistently cascaded across existing channels and live forums You may be a good fit if you Have 8–12 years of experience in communications or an adjacent craft where you learned to make complex, high-stakes material clear under pressure (e.g journalism, speechwriting, chief of staff work, strategy and operations) Are an exceptional writer with a particular talent for distilling technical decisions and cross-functional projects into simple, compelling narratives, and can write convincingly in someone else's voice Have served as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and know how to build those relationships: when to push, when to listen, and how to deliver a recommendation even when it’s something an exec may not want to hear Can embed credibly with engineers, PMs, and researchers. You are curious about how technical systems work, ask good questions, and earn the trust of people who may be skeptical of comms by default See the big picture and are able to connect individual team updates to company strategy and mission Have a keen eye for organizational culture and can recognize authentic moments worth amplifying Strong candidates may also Have experience communicating about product ,engineering, security, infrastructure, or other technical domains Have worked at AI companies, frontier tech companies, or other organizations where the technical work moves faster than most people can follow Have built or run internal communications programs during periods of rapid organizational growth The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $295,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
